{{Top|leg}}
A '''power terminal''' was an energy distribution station, where [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and vehicles could be taken for recharging. Other terminals were used for powering [[computer terminal]]s.

The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[deflection tower]]s<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> served as power terminals.<ref name="anhn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>
